completion_decisions: The target has no located public implementation or machine-readable Figure 10/11 arrays; every missing field is isolated in the versioned contract.
The direct MDPSO and 3-D wake predecessors were legally recovered and used before any lower-authority completion.
The visible exactly-5D diagnostic resolves the paper text's strict-spacing ambiguity in favor of at-least 5D.
Jensen and Jensen-Gaussian are comparison baselines, not separate target packages.
Twenty-five independent seeds implement the platform protocol because the paper omits a repeat count.
missing_information: C, k0, I0 and complete target wake calibration
initialization, random seeds and repeat count
velocity limits and exact constraint handling

paper.title: Wind farm layout optimization with a three-dimensional Gaussian wake model

paper_source_conflicts: The spacing equation prints a strict inequality while the paper diagnostic uses exactly 5D.
